name: lore
description: A knowledge engine for AI coding agents — captures 'facts you cannot derive from the code' at session end, stores them as reviewable markdown in each repo (docs/ai-knowledge/), retrieves them on demand via path-scoped rules, and closes the loop with usage metrics. Skills: init / memorize / knowledge-consolidate / resolve-merge / set-language, plus SessionStart/Stop gates and an index generator. See README.md.
